entities.summary: Adam Mensah Osei Afriyie is a British politician who served as the member of parliament (MP) for Windsor from 2005 to 2024. He is a member of the Conservative Party. Adam Afriyie was a performers & entertainers from Wimbledon (b. 1965-08-04, Wimbledon). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
